Review OpenRouter Model Fusion?

"Reviewers, almost all founders, describe OpenRouter Model Fusion mainly as a practical multi-model gateway: one API to access many models, switch providers quickly, compare outputs, and route each task to the best fit without juggling keys or separate integrations. Makers of Kilo Code, Devin by Cognition, and Budibase highlight OpenAI-compatible access, failover, pricing clarity, and faster experimentation. The only real caveat is narrow: one founder says they still use another tool for some models and rely on OpenRouter for specific coverage like Grok."
